name: Vayu Local API Client and Load Tester
free_limit: Free local desktop API client and native C++ load-testing engine with no subscription, paid tier or feature gating; no vendor-imposed usage quota or expiry.
watch_out: Runs on the user's own computer; no free hosted load generators, cloud compute or bandwidth. Engine is AGPL-3.0 and UI Apache-2.0; network-service modifications to AGPL code can trigger source-sharing obligations. Load tests may incur costs or violate target API rate limits.
